title: MigrateLib: a tool for end-to-end Python library migration
abstract: arXiv:2510.08810v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Library migration is the process of replacing a library with a similar one in a software project. Manual library migration is time consuming and error prone, as it requires developers to understand the Application Programming Interfaces (API) of both libraries, map equivalent APIs, and perform the necessary code transformations. Due to the difficulty of the library migration process, most of the existing automated techniques and tooling stop at the API mapping stage or support a limited set of libraries and code transformations. In this paper, we develop an end-to-end solution that can automatically migrate code between any arbitrary pair of Python libraries that provide similar functionality. Due to the promising capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) in code generation and transformation, we use LLMs as the primary engine for migration. translated_title: MigrateLib：一个端到端的Python库迁移工具
translated_abstract: 库迁移是指在软件项目中用一个类似的库替换另一个库的过程。手动进行库迁移既耗时又容易出错，因为它要求开发者理解两个库的应用程序编程接口（API），映射等效的API，并执行必要的代码转换。由于库迁移过程的困难性，现有的大多数自动化技术和工具要么止步于API映射阶段，要么仅支持有限的库集合和代码转换。在本文中，我们开发了一个端到端的解决方案，能够在任何提供相似功能的任意一对Python库之间自动迁移代码。鉴于大语言模型（LLM）在代码生成和转换方面展现出的强大能力，我们使用LLM作为迁移的主要引擎。在构建该工具之前，我们首先研究了LLM在库迁移方面的能力……
tldr: 该论文提出了MigrateLib，一个以大语言模型为核心引擎的端到端Python库自动迁移工具，能够在任意一对功能相似的Python库之间自动完成代码迁移，突破了现有工具仅支持有限库和部分迁移阶段的局限。
en_tdlr: This paper presents MigrateLib, an end-to-end tool that leverages Large Language Models as the primary engine to automatically migrate code between any arbitrary pair of Python libraries with similar functionality, overcoming the limitations of existing tools that support only a limited set of libraries or stop at the API mapping stage.
